# libcurl option-like entry points

Every option-like constant of the libcurl API: easy, multi and share options, getinfo codes, URL API parts and flags, header origins and websocket flags. Names are parsed from `include/curl/*.h`; values are computed by a gcc probe compiled against `include/`. Each name is cross-checked against `lib/easyoptions.c` (generated by `lib/optiontable.pl` from `include/curl/curl.h`; this is the table `curl_easy_option_by_name/by_id/next` return), `include/curl/typecheck-gcc.h`, `docs/libcurl/opts/*.md` and `docs/libcurl/symbols-in-versions`. Doc fields (protocols, TLS backends, DEFAULT) are documentation claims, not verified behaviour. The JSON holds the complete record.

| Group | Count |
|---|---|
| CURLOPT_* options | 312 |
| CURLOPT_* aliases | 15 |
| CURLOPT_* obsolete (= 9999) | 4 |
| CURLOPT_* removed (symbols-in-versions has a last version) | 16 |
| CURLOPT numbers unused below the highest | 20 |
| lib/easyoptions.c rows | 327 |
| CURLMOPT_* options | 21 |
| CURLMINFO_* entries | 7 |
| CURLSHOPT_* entries | 7 |
| CURL_LOCK_DATA_* entries | 9 |
| CURLUPART_* entries | 11 |
| CURLU_* flags | 16 |
| CURLINFO_* infos | 78 |
| CURLH_* origins | 5 |
| CURLWS_* flags | 9 |
| discrepancies | 17 |

### Reserved and obsolete numbers

Numbers below the highest assigned that no current option uses (the numbering space is shared by all `CURLOPTTYPE_*` bases): 8, 30, 35, 38, 40, 49, 55, 66, 67, 72, 73, 122, 123, 124, 125, 126, 127, 128, 132, 133.

Obsolete names defined to 9999: CURLOPT_CLOSEPOLICY (CURLOPT_OBSOLETE72), CURLOPT_OBSOLETE40 (9999), CURLOPT_OBSOLETE72 (9999), CURLOPT_WRITEINFO (CURLOPT_OBSOLETE40) (hypothesis: the OBSOLETE<n> names record retired numbers [40, 72]).

Names removed from the header (symbols-in-versions lists a last version); their former numbers are not recorded in this tree:

## ABI-relevant notes

Disagreements between the sources above. These are recorded, not resolved; `typecheck-unchecked` means a C caller gets no compile-time argument type warning from gcc for that option.

| Kind | Name | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| doc-synopsis-type-mismatch | CURLMOPT_CHUNK_LENGTH_PENALTY_SIZE | header OFF_T, doc synopsis 'CURLMcode curl_multi_setopt(CURLM *handle, CURLMOPT_CHUNK_LENGTH_PENALTY_SIZE, long size);' |
| doc-synopsis-type-mismatch | CURLMOPT_CONTENT_LENGTH_PENALTY_SIZE | header OFF_T, doc synopsis 'CURLMcode curl_multi_setopt(CURLM *handle, CURLMOPT_CONTENT_LENGTH_PENALTY_SIZE, long size);' |
| doc-synopsis-type-mismatch | CURLOPT_REQUEST_TARGET | header STRINGPOINT, doc synopsis 'CURLcode curl_easy_setopt(CURL *handle, CURLOPT_REQUEST_TARGET, string);' |
| no-op-undef | CURLOPT_DNS_USE_GLOBAL_CACHE | include/curl/curl.h does #undef CURLOPT_DNS_USE_GLOBAL_CACHE under CURL_NO_OLDIES, but it is an enum member, not a macro, so it stays visible |
| typecheck-class-mismatch | CURLMOPT_NOTIFYDATA | in typecheck class cb_data but header type is OBJECTPOINT |
| typecheck-class-mismatch | CURLMOPT_PUSHDATA | in typecheck class cb_data but header type is OBJECTPOINT |
| typecheck-class-mismatch | CURLMOPT_SOCKETDATA | in typecheck class cb_data but header type is OBJECTPOINT |
| typecheck-class-mismatch | CURLMOPT_TIMERDATA | in typecheck class cb_data but header type is OBJECTPOINT |
| typecheck-unchecked | CURLINFO_PRIVATE | CURLINFO_STRING info has no curl_easy_getinfo type check |
| typecheck-unchecked | CURLOPT_CAINFO_BLOB | BLOB option has no curl_easy_setopt type check in typecheck-gcc.h |
| typecheck-unchecked | CURLOPT_ISSUERCERT_BLOB | BLOB option has no curl_easy_setopt type check in typecheck-gcc.h |
| typecheck-unchecked | CURLOPT_PROXY_CAINFO_BLOB | BLOB option has no curl_easy_setopt type check in typecheck-gcc.h |
| typecheck-unchecked | CURLOPT_PROXY_ISSUERCERT_BLOB | BLOB option has no curl_easy_setopt type check in typecheck-gcc.h |
| typecheck-unchecked | CURLOPT_PROXY_SSLCERT_BLOB | BLOB option has no curl_easy_setopt type check in typecheck-gcc.h |
| typecheck-unchecked | CURLOPT_PROXY_SSLKEY_BLOB | BLOB option has no curl_easy_setopt type check in typecheck-gcc.h |
| typecheck-unchecked | CURLOPT_SSLCERT_BLOB | BLOB option has no curl_easy_setopt type check in typecheck-gcc.h |
